observed.caption: Wind turbines line green hills above a forested valley with scattered buildings and a waste pile under a hazy sky.
observed.description: The image shows a wide outdoor landscape with dense green trees and vegetation filling the foreground and lower half, several multi-story light-colored buildings with reddish roofs visible in the midground to the right among trees, and a large light-colored piled waste area on the far right. Behind the buildings, rolling green hills extend across the background, lined along the ridge with numerous white wind turbines and a few thin lattice communication towers. The sky above the hills is pale and hazy, and the scene is lit by bright daylight.
